metadata.description: Viva Engage skills for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI - UI-level automation with Playwright: sessions, posts, polls, praise, comments, reactions, best answers, roles, pins, events

plugins.name: viva-engage
plugins.description: Automate Viva Engage through its web UI as many different users - recorded sessions and automatic sign-in, robust locators, idempotent runners, content creation (discussions, questions, announcements, polls, praise, comments, replies, mentions, images, topics), engagement (reactions, votes, best answers, stand-in users) and community administration (members and roles, pins, info, events, favorites)
